title: Bringing a Ridgecrest Advantage Membership to an End at the Member’s Own Election
content:
A member of a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan who elects to leave the plan has their enrollment brought to an end and what they are left owing for plan premium settled as a closing premium balance written on the enrollment.

The closing premium balance is not struck before the premium relief the member is owed stands on the premium account as a credit entry. Until such a credit entry stands on that premium account, no closing premium balance is struck.

The enrollment is moved out of coverage and marked as ended by the member's own election, coverage is dated to the last day of the month the plan is handling the election in, the plan premium still owed is written on the enrollment as the member's closing balance, and the member's own recorded request to leave is marked as carried out. Afterwards the member is no longer covered by the plan from the day after that coverage end date, and the closing balance is the figure they will be billed for.

### How the ending is recorded

This is the member's own action. The tool `end_plan_membership_007ca425` is first unlocked and then handed over to be run by the customer themselves, rather than run by the representative.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `advantage_enrollment_id` | The reference number of the member's Medicare Advantage enrollment that is being brought to an end, read from their enrollment record before the call | An identifier |
| `advantage_enrollment_request_id` | The reference number of the member's own recorded request to leave the plan, read from their enrollment intake record before the call | An identifier |
| `closing_premium_balance` | The plan premium the member is left owing, in USD | A decimal number carried to 2 decimal places, rounded half away from zero to the nearest cent at the moment it is passed; zero is written as 0.0, and an empty value is not accepted |

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the enrollment reference number that has been ended, the last day of coverage as YYYY-MM-DD, and the closing plan premium balance written to two decimal places in USD. The sentence is returned only once the enrollment has been moved out of coverage and the balance written on it, so its presence is what indicates the call completed.

### What the member is told

Success is the confirmation the member receives naming the last day of their coverage and the balance left owing.
